description: Search the full text of every SEC filing since 2001 (the EDGAR full-text index). Returns matching filing documents with company, form, date, 8-K item codes, and a SEC.gov link. Quote a phrase for exact match; filter by form and date range.

enddt.description: Only filings on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the result set (default 0).

q.description: Search query. Quote a phrase ("climate change") for an exact match; space-separated terms are ANDed.

startdt.description: Only filings on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: search_filings
title: Full-text search across SEC filings
